scope: CVG-004 bounded authenticated billing API to durable outbox to real worker process proof

criteria.description: The public worker-chain gap, bounded contract, owner and exclusions are recorded without promoting CVG-004 or global readiness.
criteria.limitations: The gate authorizes only one local authenticated billing event path and its disposable process proof.

criteria.description: The API publishes billing.record.created, the outbox repository is durable, the worker registers required consumers and the durable inbox guard is available in the current runtime.
criteria.limitations: Current evidence shows the components separately; the new process contract must prove their public-to-worker composition.

criteria.description: A focused RED process contract can reject synthetic outbox seeding, missing restricted roles, missing health consumers, incomplete inbox claims and duplicate processing.
criteria.limitations: Implementation and real PostgreSQL/process verification are required before a bounded PASS can be recorded.

gaps: The RED process contract, implementation/fixture completion, real process execution and independent critique are not complete at gate creation.

authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded authenticated billing API to durable outbox to real worker process proof
authority.decision: Authorize reversible repository implementation and disposable PostgreSQL/process verification of one account-scoped billing.record.created chain; providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, external mutation, long-lived consumer policy and release remain excluded.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before adding provider delivery, target behavior, new event families, long-lived consumer policy, migration or release acceptance.

next_action: Write and run the focused RED process contract, then implement only the minimal fixture/runtime hardening needed to prove the public billing event chain.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to billing route publication, outbox transaction semantics, consumer registration or worker bootstrap
Expansion beyond the billing.record.created success/restart/idempotency path
Any provider, target, production, deployment or long-lived worker behavior change
